professionalSummary.text: Three years of experience as an Implementation Consultant at an HR software company, configuring payroll and absence products for 23 mid‑size employers in accordance with the company’s configuration standard.
professionalSummary.witness: Implementation consultant at an HR software company for three years, configuring the payroll and absence products for twenty-three mid-sized employers under the configuration standard.

experienceHighlights.text: Led policy workshops using the workshop method, capturing policy decisions, resolving internal disagreements, and obtaining customer sign‑off on workshop records.
experienceHighlights.witness: Ran the policy workshops for each implementation under the workshop method; the workshop records show the policy decisions captured, including the disagreements within customer teams resolved into a recorded decision, with the customers' sign-off on each workshop record.

experienceHighlights.text: Loaded and reconciled customer employee data with the data migration team, producing signed reconciliation reports.
experienceHighlights.witness: Loaded and reconciled each customer's employee data with the data migration team, with the reconciliation report signed by the customer's HR lead.

experienceHighlights.text: Trained customers’ HR administrators following a structured training plan; documented go‑live responsibilities and obtained manager approval on the go‑live checklist.
experienceHighlights.witness: Trained the customers' HR administrators under the training plan; go-live approval was the implementation manager's, recorded on the go-live checklist together with which checks were mine.

experienceHighlights.text: Authored limitation notes and hand‑over conditions for each implementation, compiling them into a hand‑over pack for the support team.
experienceHighlights.witness: Wrote the limitation note and the hand-over conditions for each implementation in the hand-over pack to the support team.

projectsAndWorkSamples.text: Provided tangible work samples: two signed workshop records, one reconciliation report, one go‑live checklist with manager approval, and a hand‑over pack, all linked to implementation tool references.
projectsAndWorkSamples.witness: Work sample: two workshop records with the customers' sign-off, one reconciliation report, one go-live checklist with the manager's approval and one hand-over pack, with the implementation tool references as a verification trail.

skills.text: Configuration of payroll and absence products

skills.witness: In the workshop exercise, when the two panel members playing the customer disagreed on the overtime policy, the candidate wrote both positions on the board, asked which payroll rule each would produce, showed the two resulting payslips, and recorded the decision the customer then made with the name of the decider.

skills.text: Documentation of implementation boundaries and hand-over conditions

evidence.text: Implementation consultant at an HR software company for three years, configuring the payroll and absence products for twenty-three mid-sized employers under the configuration standard.

Ran the policy workshops for each implementation under the workshop method; the workshop records show the policy decisions captured, including the disagreements within customer teams resolved into a recorded decision, with the customers' sign-off on each workshop record.

In the workshop exercise, when the two panel members playing the customer disagreed on the overtime policy, the candidate wrote both positions on the board, asked which payroll rule each would produce, showed the two resulting payslips, and recorded the decision the customer then made with the name of the decider.
Loaded and reconciled each customer's employee data with the data migration team, with the reconciliation report signed by the customer's HR lead.
Trained the customers' HR administrators under the training plan; go-live approval was the implementation manager's, recorded on the go-live checklist together with which checks were mine.
Wrote the limitation note and the hand-over conditions for each implementation in the hand-over pack to the support team.
